selection_policy: All robustness/model decisions frozen from February grouped CV before March diagnostic settlement; no March outcome optimization.

robust_frozen_specification.reason: No single family removal improves February CV; regularization plateau is broad from C=.5 to2.0; fold top3 capture remains 40.2-42.8%.

ticket_substitution_audit.note: Substitution is not monotonic: Wave57 loses one Wave55 hit but adds three different hits. No March outcome was used to select these substitutions.

conclusion: Wave57 survives the planned robustness audit. February fold performance is stable, regularization is not knife-edge, and removing any single interaction family worsens February CV. Racer-strength interactions and pair-relative gaps are the most important families but neither is solely responsible. Freeze the Wave57 opponent specification now; do not continue tuning on March. Next evidence should come from a genuinely untouched future period.
